insights.title: Practice insights
insights.description: Your own practice report, computed from this workspace only. No comparison with other lawyers.
insights.offline: You are offline. These are the figures computed {when}.
insights.scopeOwn: Your own appearances and measures only.
insights.shortcutsHint: Press [ or ] to change the range, t to switch between chart and table.

empty.title: Insights appear after your first few court days
empty.body: Once hearings have passed, this page shows how many you prepared for and kept up with.

hero.label: Prepared & Kept
hero.summary: Prepared and kept: {percent} percent of {n} appearances. Previous period: {previous} percent.
hero.summaryAlone: Prepared and kept: {percent} percent of {n} appearances.
hero.noRate: No appearances in this range are decided yet.
hero.pending: {n} appearances still wait on an obligation and are not counted yet.
hero.definitionTitle: What counts as prepared and kept
hero.definition: A listed appearance counts when a current brief was confirmed before the hearing, and every obligation arising from that hearing is captured, owned, and either kept or deliberately rescheduled. Appearances still waiting on an obligation are left out until decided.

obligations.title: Obligations kept
obligations.summary: {kept} of {due} due obligations kept; {missed} missed; {reschedules} deliberately rescheduled.
obligations.none: No obligations fell due in this range.
obligations.captureNote: {captured} of {total} directions from orders have an owner and a due date.
obligations.rescheduleNote: A deliberate reschedule, with its reason, is never a miss.

preparedness.title: Preparedness
preparedness.hidden: Preparedness appears after at least 5 ratings. Ratings so far: {n}.

load.title: Load
load.summary: Demand {demand}, worry {worry}, effort {effort} (1 to 5) across {n} weekly pulses.
load.hidden: Load appears after at least 5 weekly pulses. Pulses so far: {n}.

report.title: Practice report
report.baselineDefinition: Baseline: ratings and pulses recorded in the workspace's first 7 days. The change is the average now minus the baseline average.
report.missedDefinition: Missed: an obligation past its due date that is still open and was never deliberately rescheduled.
report.private: Computed from this workspace only. It contains no data from other workspaces and is not shared anywhere.
